verdict.rationale: Neon documents a built-in connection pooler (PgBouncer-based) enabled via a dedicated pooled connection endpoint, described in official docs as a first-class feature (neon-docs-13/30), eliminating the need to operate a separate pgbouncer/proxy. missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarks proving thousands-of-connections scale, and no community corroboration specifically about pooler behavior under load (community comments focus on branching/pricing/storage, not pooling).
